name: KanbanTable
description: a kanban board table interactive grid for organizing items by status <table>
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `role="region"` -- defines the Kanban board as a named landmark section
`aria-label={label}` -- provides an accessible name for the board region
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `label`: string (required) -- accessible name describing the board, applied via `aria-label`
`children`: slot (required) -- the board content including columns and cards
